title: fix(ui): follow system color-mode changes when no override is saved
author: ale-rls

gist.summary: The shared @pollinations/ui color-mode store now follows system light/dark preference changes when no choice is saved, updating both the hook and the page’s dark-mode class. A saved choice still takes precedence, and cross-tab synchronization remains intact. The system listener attaches when the first consumer subscribes and is removed when the last unsubscribes. Added a regression test and bumped @pollinations/ui from 0.1.0-alpha.12 to 0.1.0-alpha.13.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden workspace, Polli watches a retro monitor shift gently between light and dark as a little system-preference dial turns; a saved-choice note keeps a second lamp steady beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny reading glasses and stays small within the scene. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
